# EPS regression fixtures

Original three-point plots generated for this suite with Matplotlib 3.10.8,
`ps.fonttype` set to 3 and 42. Embedded DejaVu Sans glyphs retain the adjacent
DejaVu/Bitstream notice. Plot content is MIT like the WasmTex test suite.
The scientific title includes Greek letters to exercise glyph mapping.
These are regression samples, not a complete EPS compatibility corpus.
